svg.text: CJ2 Voice Emergency Checklist — DIY Wiring Diagram
ESP32-S3 + INMP441 mic + MAX98357A amp + microSD + Applied Avionics split-legend annunciator switch
Pin numbers match firmware/main/board_pins.h • DEMO / TRAINING ONLY — NOT FOR FLIGHT
L/R to GND (left ch) - SD: 100k to GND
GPIO cannot drive a 28 V lamp directly - use a
SELECT G10 to GND when IN
USB/VIN -> amp VIN (best output); lamp rail separate
common ground - ALL devices + lamp driver source
Budget: logic + peripherals < 250 mA; amp adds up to ~650 mA peak at 5V/4ohm - size USB >= 1 A.
